The graph of $y=f(x),$ shown above, consists of three line segments. Find the value of ${\int }_{-5}^{4}f(x)\,\text{d}x.$
worked_solution:
We divide the interval of integration into $4$ regions: the line segment for $x\in [-5,-3],$ the line segment for $x\in [-3,-1],$ the line segment for $x\in (-1,1),$ and the line segment for $x\in [1,4].$ Therefore, we can write the required integral as follows:

$$
{\int }_{-5}^{4}f(x)\,\text{d}x={{{\int }_{-5}^{-3}f(x)\,\text{d}x}_{⏟}}_{{A}_{1}}+{{{\int }_{-3}^{-1}f(x)\,\text{d}x}_{⏟}}_{-{A}_{2}}+{{{\int }_{-1}^{1}f(x)\,\text{d}x}_{⏟}}_{{A}_{3}}+{{{\int }_{1}^{4}f(x)\,\text{d}x}_{⏟}}_{-{A}_{4}}
$$

- The $1$st integral represents the signed area between the curve and the $x$-axis, where $x\in [-5,-3].$ The corresponding region is a right triangle, so we find the area using the formula

$$
\begin{aligned}{A}_{1} & =\frac{1}{2}(bh) \\  & =\frac{1}{2}(2\cdot 2) \\  & =2.\end{aligned}
$$

- The $2$nd integral represents the signed area between the curve and the $x$-axis, where $x\in [-3,-1].$ The corresponding region is a right triangle, so we find the area using the formula

$$
\begin{aligned}{A}_{2} & =\frac{1}{2}(bh) \\  & =\frac{1}{2}(2\cdot 2) \\  & =2.\end{aligned}
$$

Since the region lies below the $x$-axis, we have

$$
{\int }_{-4}^{-1}f(x)\,\text{d}x=-{A}_{2}=-2.
$$

- The $3$rd integral represents the signed area between the curve and the $x$-axis, where $x\in (-1,1).$ The corresponding region is a square, so we find the area using the formula

$$
\begin{aligned}{A}_{3} & ={s}^{2} \\  & ={2}^{2} \\  & =4.\end{aligned}
$$

- The $4$th integral represents the signed area between the curve and the $x$-axis, where $x\in [1,4].$ The corresponding region is a triangle, so we find the area using the formula

$$
\begin{aligned}{A}_{4} & =\frac{1}{2}(bh) \\  & =\frac{1}{2}(3\cdot 3) \\  & =4.5.\end{aligned}
$$

Since the region lies below the $x$-axis, we have

$$
{\int }_{1}^{4}f(x)\,\text{d}x=-{A}_{4}=-4.5.
$$

Finally, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{-5}^{4}f(x)\,\text{d}x & ={A}_{1}-{A}_{2}+{A}_{3}-{A}_{4} \\  & =2-2+4-4.5 \\  & =-0.5.\end{aligned}
$$
